tools.name: get_brand_profile
tools.title: Get brand profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's brand profile from Ivero: brand name, website, sector, geographic coverage, objectives and contact info.

tools.name: list_audit_reports
tools.title: List AI influence audits
tools.description: List the signed-in user's Ivero audit reports (AI influence diagnostics), most recent first. Returns id, date, overall score, status label, and audited site URL.

tools.name: get_audit_report
tools.title: Get audit report detail
tools.description: Return the full detail of a single Ivero audit report by id: overall score, per-pillar breakdown, radar data, keyword cloud and per-engine mentions.

id.description: Audit report id. Use `list_audit_reports` first, or omit to fetch the most recent.

tools.name: list_competitors
tools.title: List tracked competitors
tools.description: List the signed-in user's tracked competitors in Ivero.
